taxonomy.label: Storage

products.name: Meuse Executive
products.desc: Ergonomic mesh, hydraulic gas lift, solid structural frame with multiple base options.
products.longDesc: The definitive executive chair. A breathable mesh back is paired with a deep, hand-upholstered seat and a synchro-tilt mechanism that follows the body through the day. Specified across leadership floors and focus rooms alike.

products.name: Meuse Conference
products.desc: Stackable conference chair with cushioned seat, chrome sled base, and upholstered back.
products.longDesc: A refined visitor and conference chair with a fully upholstered seat and back. The sprung sled base flexes subtly as you settle, and chairs stack four-high for fast room turnarounds.

products.name: Diablo Modular Sofa
products.desc: Plush modular felt cushions with architectural brass-tipped steel frame. Multiple configuration options.
products.longDesc: A modular lounge system built around an architectural brass-tipped steel frame. Specify straight runs, corners and islands; high-resilience foam holds its shape through years of reception traffic.

products.name: Diablo Bench
products.desc: Linear bench system for waiting areas, corridors, and informal meeting zones.
products.longDesc: A linear upholstered bench for waiting areas, corridors and transit zones. Gang multiple units into continuous runs; an optional low back adds comfort without blocking sightlines.

products.name: Loire Boardroom
products.desc: Chamfered walnut wood slab table with steel modular legs. Seats 8-16.
products.longDesc: A statement boardroom table with a chamfered solid-timber slab and architectural steel legs. Integrated power and data grommets keep the surface clear; lengths are made to order.

products.name: Loire Round
products.desc: Circular meeting table in solid oak or walnut. Perfect for 4-6 person huddle spaces.
products.longDesc: A circular meeting table on a sculpted central column, sized for four-to-six person huddles. Available in solid oak or walnut with an optional flush power module.

products.name: Flamingo Lounge
products.desc: Iconic swivel lounge chair. Sculptural walnut plywood shell with luxurious leather finish.
products.longDesc: An iconic swivel lounge chair: a sculptural moulded-plywood shell cradles a deep leather or fabric cushion, returning gently to centre on its polished base. A signature piece for reception and executive lounges.

products.name: Seine Reception Desk
products.desc: Curved reception counter in premium wood veneer with integrated lighting and cable management.
products.longDesc: A curved reception counter in premium veneer with an integrated LED light line and a DDA-compliant lowered section. Configured to your lobby footprint in custom widths and radii.

products.name: Rhone Collaborative Table
products.desc: Oval collaborative table with power integration, cable management, and whiteboard surface.
products.longDesc: An oval collaborative bench for hot-desking and project teams. A central cable spine routes power to every seat, and an optional writable top turns the surface into a thinking space.

products.name: Marne Storage Wall
products.desc: Modular storage wall with open shelving, closed cabinets, and integrated display niches.
products.longDesc: A modular storage wall that organises and divides open-plan space. Combine open shelving, push-to-open cabinets and lit display niches into bespoke widths and heights.

products.name: Durance Breakout Sofa
products.desc: Modular curved sofa for informal breakout spaces. Available in 30+ fabric options.
products.longDesc: A gently curved modular sofa that shapes informal breakout zones. Arc segments build circles and serpentines; an acoustic-backed option helps tame open-plan noise.

products.name: Garonne Bar Table
products.desc: Height-adjustable round bar table for standing meetings and informal exchanges.
products.longDesc: A round bar-height table for stand-up meetings and informal exchanges. A weighted column keeps it stable, with an optional footrest ring and flush power for laptops.

products.name: Meuse High-Back
products.desc: High-back executive chair with extended headrest and full-grain leather seat.
products.longDesc: The Meuse High-Back extends the executive line with a sculpted headrest and full-grain leather upholstery. A continuous mesh-and-leather back cradles the full spine; the synchro-tilt mechanism locks in five positions.

products.name: Meuse Task
products.desc: Compact task chair for focused workstations. Mesh back, breathable seat, castor base.
products.longDesc: A compact task variant of the Meuse line, engineered for dense workstation layouts. The mesh back keeps air moving through long sessions; a simpler mechanism trims weight and cost without sacrificing the synchro-tilt feel.

products.name: Meuse Visitor
products.desc: Visitor chair with padded seat and back, sled base. Stacks four-high.
products.longDesc: A lighter visitor variant of the Meuse conference chair. The sled base flexes as you settle; upholstery wraps the seat and back in a single clean line. Stacks four-high for flexible room reconfiguration.

products.name: Aube Executive
products.desc: Executive chair with sculpted plywood shell, leather seat, and pedestal base.
products.longDesc: The Aube Executive pairs a sculpted plywood shell with a deep leather seat and a sculpted pedestal base. A quieter, more residential executive language — specified in leadership suites and private offices.

products.name: Aube Task
products.desc: Agile task chair with mesh back and fabric seat. Lightweight and quick to adjust.
products.longDesc: The Aube Task brings the collection’s clean lines to the open-plan floor. A single-lever mechanism controls height and tilt; the mesh back keeps the chair light enough to move between desks.

products.name: Aube Conference
products.desc: Conference chair with upholstered shell and four-leg base. Links in rows.
products.longDesc: A conference chair with a fully upholstered shell and a powder-coated four-leg base. Chairs link in straight rows for boardrooms and auditoriums; the seat foam is tuned for two-hour meetings.

products.name: Aube Stack
products.desc: Stackable training chair with thin upholstery and sled base. Stacks eight-high.
products.longDesc: A stackable training and event chair. The thin upholstered seat keeps weight down; the sled base stacks eight-high on a transport dolly. The first choice for flexible training and event spaces.

products.name: Aube High-Back
products.desc: High-back executive with integrated headrest and premium leather. For leadership suites.
products.longDesc: The Aube High-Back brings a residential warmth to the executive floor. A wrapped leather back rises to an integrated headrest; the plywood shell is visible from behind, lending the chair a sculptural presence.

products.name: Diablo Corner Sofa
products.desc: Corner module for the Diablo system. Builds L-shapes, U-shapes, and islands.
products.longDesc: The Diablo Corner module extends the modular lounge system into L-shaped and U-shaped configurations. The same brass-tipped steel frame and high-resilience foam as the straight modules; specify with or without armrests.

products.name: Diablo Ottoman
products.desc: Upholstered ottoman for the Diablo system. Coffee table, extra seat, or footrest.
products.longDesc: A versatile upholstered ottoman that pairs with the Diablo sofa system. Use it as a coffee table surface, an extra seat, or a footrest. The same frame and foam as the bench modules.

products.name: Flamingo Ottoman
products.desc: Matching ottoman for the Flamingo lounge chair. Sculptural plywood shell, leather cushion.
products.longDesc: The Flamingo Ottoman completes the lounge chair setting. The same moulded-plywood shell cradles a leather or fabric cushion at footrest height. A quiet companion that doesn’t compete with the chair’s sculptural line.

products.name: Somme Lounge Chair
products.desc: Deep lounge chair with wraparound back and swivel base. Bouclé or leather.
products.longDesc: The Somme Lounge Chair wraps the body in a deep, enveloping back. A swivel base returns gently to centre; the seat is hand-upholstered in bouclé, leather, or velvet. A signature piece for executive lounges and quiet rooms.

products.name: Somme Sofa
products.desc: Three-seat lounge sofa with deep cushions and low profile. For reception and executive loungges.
products.longDesc: The Somme Sofa brings the lounge chair’s deep comfort to a three-seat format. A low, architectural profile keeps sightlines open in reception spaces; the down-wrapped foam cushions hold their shape through years of use.

products.name: Somme 2-Seat
products.desc: Compact two-seat sofa for private offices and small lounge corners.
products.longDesc: A compact two-seat variant of the Somme lounge sofa. Sized for private offices, executive quiet rooms, and small reception corners where the three-seat would overwhelm. Same deep cushions, same low profile.

products.name: Durance Curve Module
products.desc: Single curved arc module for the Durance breakout system. Builds circles and serpentines.
products.longDesc: A single 30-degree arc module for the Durance breakout system. Combine twelve modules into a full circle, or serpentines through open-plan space. An acoustic-backed option helps tame open-plan noise.

products.name: Vie Lounge Chair
products.desc: Transitional lounge chair with moulded shell and leather seat. For lounge and dining.
products.longDesc: The Vie Lounge Chair sits between lounge and dining. A moulded plywood shell is shaped for relaxed sitting but upright enough for a meal. The leather or fabric seat is hand-stitched; the base returns to centre on a swivel.

products.name: Vie Dining Chair
products.desc: Dining chair with moulded plywood shell and upholstered seat. For cafeteria and boardroom.
products.longDesc: A dining-height chair that brings the Vie collection’s transitional language to the cafeteria and boardroom table. The plywood shell is shaped for a meal’s duration; the upholstered seat is tuned for comfort through a long lunch.

products.name: Loire Boardroom XL
products.desc: Extended boardroom table for 16–20 seats. Boat-shape top with integrated power.
products.longDesc: The Loire Boardroom XL extends the line for larger boards. A subtle boat-shape top keeps sightlines clear to the screen; integrated power and data grommets serve every seat. Made to order in walnut or oak.

products.name: Loire Square
products.desc: Square meeting table for 4–8 person huddle and focus spaces.
products.longDesc: A square meeting table on a sculpted central column, sized for four-to-eight person huddles. Available in solid oak or walnut with an optional flush power module. Pairs with Meuse or Aube conference chairs.

products.name: Loire Meeting
products.desc: Rectangular meeting table for 6–10 person project spaces.
products.longDesc: A rectangular meeting table sized for six-to-ten person project spaces. The solid-timber top sits on architectural legs; integrated cable management keeps the surface clear for laptops and whiteboards.

products.name: Loire Console
products.desc: Slim console table in solid timber. For lobby display and corridor galleries.
products.longDesc: A slim console table in solid timber. The chamfered top sits on a architectural steel frame; the proportions are tuned for lobby display plinths and corridor gallery surfaces. Made to order in oak or walnut.

products.name: Seine Console Table
products.desc: Matching console for the Seine reception desk. Display plinth and visitor sign-in.
products.longDesc: A matching console for the Seine reception desk. Use it as a display plinth, a visitor sign-in surface, or a waiting-area side table. The same veneer and LED light line as the main counter.

products.name: Seine Standing Counter
products.desc: Standing-height reception counter for visitor check-in and badge printing.
products.longDesc: A standing-height companion to the Seine reception desk. Visitors check in and print badges at counter height; the DDA-compliant lowered section is retained. The same veneer and integrated LED line as the main counter.

products.name: Rhone Bench Desk
products.desc: Double-sided bench desk for hot-desking teams. Central power spine, shared cable route.
products.longDesc: A double-sided bench desk for hot-desking teams. A central powered spine routes power to every seat; the timber top is writable on request. Pairs with Meuse or Aube task chairs for a complete agile workstation.

products.name: Garonne Poseur
products.desc: Poseur-height round table for informal meetings and café spaces.
products.longDesc: A poseur-height round table for informal stand-up meetings and social café spaces. The weighted column keeps it stable at height; an optional footrest ring and flush power make it laptop-friendly.

products.name: Isere Stand-Up Desk
products.desc: Height-adjustable stand-up desk with round top and weighted column.
products.longDesc: The Isere Stand-Up Desk brings a clean, architectural form to the standing-meeting category. A round timber top on a weighted column; an optional footrest ring and flush power for laptop sessions.

products.name: Isere Café Table
products.desc: Café-height round table for dining and social spaces. Solid timber top.
products.longDesc: A café-height round table for staff dining and social spaces. The solid timber top is warm and durable; the weighted column is stable in high-traffic cafeterias. Pairs with Vie dining chairs or Garonne stools.

products.name: Marne Credenza
products.desc: Low credenza with push-to-open doors and optional lit display niche.
products.longDesc: A low credenza from the Marne storage family. Push-to-open doors keep the front clean; an optional lit display niche runs the length of the unit. Sized for behind-sofa and under-window placement.

products.name: Marne Bookshelf
products.desc: Open-back bookshelf with adjustable shelves. For library and resource areas.
products.longDesc: An open-back bookshelf from the Marne family. Adjustable shelves hold books and resources; the open back keeps the piece light in plan. Wall-anchor standard for stability in library and resource areas.

products.name: Marne Sideboard
products.desc: Mid-height sideboard with mixed open shelving and closed cabinets.
products.longDesc: A mid-height sideboard from the Marne family that combines open display shelving with closed storage. The asymmetric layout is designed for executive offices and meeting-room credenzas. Made to order in oak or walnut.

wool-felt.label: Wool Felt
wool-felt.blurb: Dense contract wool felt — the hard-wearing everyday workhorse.

boucle.label: Bouclé
boucle.blurb: Textured wool bouclé with a soft, tactile loop.

velvet.label: Cotton Velvet
velvet.blurb: Deep-pile cotton velvet with a quiet, directional sheen.

aniline-leather.label: Aniline Leather
aniline-leather.blurb: Full-grain aniline leather that patinas beautifully with age.
